Module 10 · Session 10.3 · 34 min

Finance, tax, treasury and profitability

A source-linked technical walkthrough with an executable-system perspective.

After this session, you can:
  • Map subledger to general ledger
  • Explain tax evidence
  • Trace funding and profitability

Technical flow

1. Accounting boundary

Loan, payment, charge, waiver, write-off and recovery events produce balanced accounting projections. EOD/BOD pauses until external GL acknowledgement and exact reconciliation.

2. Tax

GST and TDS treatment is determined from versioned product, charge, party and jurisdiction facts. Returns and invoices retain source-event and correction lineage.

3. Treasury and profitability

Cash position, funding facilities, ALM, transfer pricing and product/partner profitability derive from reconciled books. Management views cannot alter customer balances or hide unsettled breaks.
